name: Utsumi Haruko
source:
A second year student and president of the chemistry club. She seems to enthusiastically do research activities, but the reality is wrapped in mystery. Her clubroom is shared with the space research club, but her relationship with Fuyuki is not good.

[Based on [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/初恋サクラメント]Wikipedia[/url]]
